Gold at 4,128.08. I want to separate "upward" from "still has room to rise."

As of 23:18 on November 9, based on XS's MT5 XAUUSDc, I organize the chart on the daily and 4-hour timeframes.

【Even above the averages, check what lies overhead】
On the 4-hour chart, SMA20 is 4,090.01 and SMA50 is 4,019.99. The 20 is above the 50, and price is above the 20. The direction leans upward.

However, the arrangement of the averages is material for reading the state of the market. It does not guarantee room for further upside in the short term. I see the range from today's/this week's high of 4,134.14 to last week's high of 4,146.89 as an overhead resistance zone. Above that is the round number 4,150.00.

【If it moves up, what to watch】
If price breaks above 4,134.14-4,146.89 and keeps moving even above 4,150.00, then 4,200.00 to the past-20-day high of 4,217.22 is interesting as the next zone to observe.

The reason is that beyond the cluster of nearby highs, the round number and the upper limit of the past 20 days lie ahead. If price only wicks up and returns inside the zone, I record it separately from a breakout.

【If it moves down, what changes】
If price falls below the previous day's high of 4,106.89 to the round number 4,100.00, I recheck the short-term strength. If price cannot hold even around the 4-hour SMA20 of 4,090.01 below that, then from today's/this week's low of 4,054.34 to the previous day's low, which is also the 4-hour trough, 4,027.44, becomes the lower zone to observe.

However, I do not treat this whole wide zone as a single support. A move breaking 4,054.34 and a move collapsing all the way to the 4,027.44 trough have different effects on the structure.

【ATR is not the remaining distance】
The daily ATR(14) is about $85.2. I will not decide "it will only move this much more" by looking only at today's high and low. ATR is a guide to the range, not an upper limit or a quota.

In verifying the hide-style indicator and the range EA as well, I want to record direction, zone position, and moves pushed back by wicks as a set. Even when it is upward, there are times to wait if price is near the upper limit, and if the range widens, I also check the expected loss amount.

4,128.08のゴールド。「上向き」と「まだ伸びる余地」は、分けて見たい。

11月9日23:18時点、XSのMT5・XAUUSDcをもとに、チャートを日足と4時間足で整理します。

【平均線の上でも、頭上は確認】
4時間足はSMA20が4,090.01、SMA50が4,019.99。20が50の上にあり、価格も20の上。方向は上向き寄りです。

ただ、平均線の並びは相場の状態を読む材料。目先の上値余地まで保証するものではありません。今日・今週高値4,134.14から先週高値4,146.89までは、頭上の抵抗帯として見ています。その上にはキリ番4,150.00もあります。

【上に進むなら何を見るか】
4,134.14〜4,146.89を上抜け、4,150.00より上でも値動きが続くなら、4,200.00〜過去20日高値4,217.22が次の観察帯として面白い。

理由は、近い高値の集まる範囲を越えた先に、キリ番と過去20日の上限が控えているから。上ヒゲだけで帯の内側へ戻る動きなら、上抜けとは分けて記録します。

【下に進むなら何が変わるか】
前日高値4,106.89〜キリ番4,100.00を下回ると、目先の強さを再点検。その下の4時間足SMA20・4,090.01付近でも価格を保てないなら、今日・今週安値4,054.34から前日安値かつ4時間足の谷4,027.44までを、下側の観察帯にします。

ただし、この広い帯全体を一つの支えとは扱いません。4,054.34を割る動きと、4,027.44の谷まで崩す動きでは、構造への影響が違います。

【ATRは残りの距離ではない】
日足ATR(14)は約85.2ドル。今日の高安だけを見て「あとこれだけ動く」とは決めません。ATRは値幅の目安で、上限でもノルマでもないからです。

hide式インジケーターやレンジEAの検証でも、方向・帯の位置・ヒゲで戻された動きをセットで残したい。上向きでも上限付近なら待つ場面があるし、値幅が広がれば想定損失額も確認する。

2120298268571914524.content_en:
Gold that fell below 4,054.34. What I want to look at now is not "did it get cheaper" but the role of the previous day's low.

As of 06:52 on November 11, XS's MT5 XAUUSDc is at 4,031.61. Because prices differ between data sources, I will unify the levels drawn on the chart using this data.

【What changed on the daily chart】
The previous day's close was 4,141.02. This daily candle has moved from a high of 4,146.63 to a low of 4,013.67, and the current price is below the previous day's low of 4,054.34.

I do not decide here that "it fell a lot, so it will bounce." Can it return inside the range of the previous day, or will it stay outside? First, I look at this difference.

【Upside is the wall after a rebound】
The focus is the round number 4,050.00 to the previous day's low of 4,054.34. It is a zone where I want to check whether the level it broke below turns into one that holds back rebounds.

If price breaks above this zone and also stays on the upper side at the candle close, then the reaction between the 4-hour SMA20 of 4,084.72 and the round number 4,100.00 is the next thing to observe. It is a way of thinking that looks at how far a move back into the previous day's range continues.

【On the downside, separate the trough from the low】
On the 4-hour chart, SMA50 at 4,025.45 and the recent trough at 4,027.44 are close together. The current price is above this zone, but this daily candle's low has already passed through it to the downside. I do not treat it as a "support that has never broken."

If price falls below this zone again and cannot stay above it even after a rebound, I will observe the zone of this daily/this week's low of 4,013.67 and the round number 4,000.00. I separate whether it breaks 4,013.67 and keeps making new lows, or returns with a wick. If it also falls below 4,000.00 and settles there, the downside range could widen.

【Why hide looks at them separately】
On the 4-hour chart, SMA20 is above SMA50. Meanwhile, price is below SMA20. The state shown by the arrangement of the averages and the current price are not aligned.

In verifying the hide-style indicator and range EA too, I want to record this phase separately from usual rebounds within the range. I will compare whether it was only a pass by wick or the close stayed outside the zone, and the subsequent price movement.

The daily ATR is about $93.1, but it is not a number showing the remaining range. In line with the size of price movement, I consider the trade volume from the loss amount I can tolerate.

Trade at your own discretion.
Verification notes are published in the open chat "Hide Gold FX Study Group" in my profile.
2120298268571914524.content_original:
4,054.34を下回ったゴールド。いま見たいのは「安くなったか」より、前日安値の役割です。

11月11日06:52時点、XSのMT5・XAUUSDcは4,031.61。配信元で価格差があるため、チャートに引く水準はこのデータで統一します。

【日足で起きた変化】
前日終値は4,141.02。今回の日足は高値4,146.63から安値4,013.67まで動き、現在値は前日安値4,054.34を下回っています。

ここで「大きく下げたから反発」とは決めません。前日までの値幅の内側へ戻れるか、それとも外側にとどまるか。まず、この違いを見ます。

【上方向は、戻した先の壁】
注目はキリ番4,050.00〜前日安値4,054.34。下回った水準が、戻りを抑える側に変わるかを確認したい帯です。

この帯を上に抜け、足の終値でも上側に残るなら、4時間足SMA20の4,084.72〜キリ番4,100.00での反応が次の観察対象。前日の値幅へ戻る動きが、どこまで続くかを見る考え方です。

【下方向は、谷と安値を分ける】
4時間足では、SMA50の4,025.45と直近の谷4,027.44が近接。現在値はこの帯の上ですが、今回の日足安値はすでに下へ通過しています。「一度も崩れていない支え」とは扱いません。

この帯を再び下回り、戻しても上に残れなければ、今回の日足・今週安値4,013.67とキリ番4,000.00の帯を観察。4,013.67を割って安値更新が続くか、ヒゲで戻すかを分けます。4,000.00も下回って定着するなら、下方向の値幅が広がる可能性も考えられます。

【hideが分けて見る理由】
4時間足はSMA20がSMA50の上。一方、価格はSMA20の下です。平均線の並びと足元の価格が示す状態は、そろっていません。

hide式インジケーターやレンジEAの検証でも、この局面は普段のレンジ内の反発と分けて記録したい。ヒゲだけの通過か、終値が帯の外に残ったか。その後の値動きを比較します。

日足ATRは約93.1ドルですが、残りの値幅を示す数字ではありません。値動きの大きさに合わせ、許容する損失額から取引量を考えます。

売買は自分の判断で。
検証メモは、プロフィールのオープンチャット「Hide Gold FX研究会」で出しています。

Gold has fallen below 4,000. If you only say "it bounced back," there are price zones you'll overlook.

As of 06:59 on November 12, XS's MT5 XAUUSDc is at 3,987.78. Today's open was 4,035.24 and the low 3,982.60, and the current price is also below yesterday's low of 4,013.67. What I want to organize on the chart is not the size of the bounce but "how much has been recovered."

【First 4,000, then yesterday's low】
The first thing to watch is today's low of 3,982.60 up to the round number 4,000.00. Even if price moves above this range, I won't judge that the decline has settled on that alone.

Next is 4,013.67 to the 4-hour SMA50 at 4,029.07. I'll check separately whether it can recover yesterday's low, and whether it can go back as far as the moving average. If it approaches from below and gets pushed back, that's material for verifying the weakness of the bounce.

If it can't get back to 4,000.00 and falls below today's and this week's low of 3,982.60, the next thing I want to observe is the round number 3,950.00. This is not a number showing a past record of bounces, but a marker for checking the price reaction. I won't assume it will be reached or bounce, and I'll also watch whether it can recover after a new low.

For verifying Hide-style indicators and range EAs too, I'd want to check, after the previous lower bound is broken, whether it's still fine to keep treating the same zone as a range. Trade at your own judgment.
